title: Image decoding lacks a visible decoded-pixel cap
description: The picker and classifier check encoded file size, then decode the selected image without a visible decoded-pixel limit. This is a possible resource-use concern, but the reviewed source establishes no affected principal or shared resource beyond the local user's own app process.
claimed_root_cause: The encoded-size limit does not bound decoded dimensions or memory use before image decoding.

trace.description: The local user opens the picker and selects an image.
The selected bytes are read into memory and decoded for preview.
Accepted encoded bytes are decoded without a visible pixel-dimension cap.

evidence.description: The preview path checks the picker-reported size before reading the file.
The configured encoded file-size cap is 20 MiB.
The classifier checks encoded file length before reading.
The classifier decodes accepted bytes before resizing, without a visible decoded-pixel cap.
The application declares the image decoder dependency.

reason: Independent source review found only a local user-selected input and possible effects confined to that user's app process. No remote input, other affected user, shared service, or operator-owned resource is established. The resource-exhaustion criteria exclude same-principal self-impact as a security finding.

title: Pull request jobs enable Flutter action caching
description: The CI workflow runs for pull requests targeting master and enables caching in the Flutter setup action in all three jobs. The repository does not establish that pull-request-controlled content can alter cached toolchain state later restored by a trusted master build.
claimed_root_cause: The pull-request workflow enables Flutter action caching without source-visible cache paths, keys, or cross-event isolation controls.

trace.description: The workflow runs for pull_request events targeting master.
The analyze job invokes the Flutter setup action before processing checked-out source.
The job requests cache behavior with cache: true; actual paths and cross-run cache effects are not defined in this file.

evidence.description: The workflow also runs on pushes to master.
The workflow handles pull_request events targeting master.
The analyze job enables the Flutter action cache.
The test job enables the Flutter action cache.
The Android build job enables the Flutter action cache.

blockers: The resolved subosito/flutter-action implementation and version-specific cache paths, keys, restore behavior, and save behavior are not present in this repository.
GitHub Actions cache access and namespace rules for pull_request and push-to-master runs are external to repository source; cross-event cache consumption is not established.

validation_plan.local: Inspect the resolved action source for the referenced version to document cache paths, keys, restore, and save behavior. Do not execute the workflow.
validation_plan.deployment: Using read-only owner access, inspect existing workflow-run metadata and Actions cache scope/access policy to determine whether a pull-request run can influence cache state later restored by a trusted master run. Do not create a test PR or modify a cache.

title: Pull request jobs may expose repository write authority to contributor-controlled code
description: All three CI jobs check out pull-request source and run Flutter commands. The workflow does not declare permissions. If effective policy grants a write-capable token and checkout makes its credentials available to later commands, contributor-controlled code could use repository authority; neither condition is established by repository source.
claimed_root_cause: The pull_request workflow executes contributor-controlled code without an explicit least-privilege permissions declaration, leaving effective credential authority to external policy and checkout behavior.

trace.description: Pull requests targeting master start the workflow.
The test job checks out the pull-request source before running Flutter commands.
The workflow runs tests after checkout; effective token permissions and credential persistence are not declared here.

evidence.description: The workflow defines analyze, test, and Android build jobs without a visible permissions block.
The analyze job checks out source before commands run.
The analyze job resolves dependencies after checkout.
The test job checks out source before commands run.
The test job executes tests after checkout.
The Android build job checks out source before commands run.
The Android build job builds a release APK after checkout.

blockers: Effective GITHUB_TOKEN permissions and any repository or organization policy overrides are not visible in this repository.
Fork pull-request secret/approval policy and branch protections are not visible in this repository.
The credential persistence behavior of the resolved actions/checkout v4 implementation is not established by this repository.

validation_plan.deployment: Using read-only owner access, inspect repository and organization Actions permission settings, fork pull-request policy, branch protections, and existing pull_request run summaries for effective permissions and checkout credential persistence. Do not create a test PR, run a probe, or attempt a write.

title: Manual sabotage test writes its backup through a predictable temporary path
description: The documented manual sabotage test opens a fixed audit_backup.py path under the system temporary directory for truncating write. A preplaced symlink could redirect that write, but repository source does not establish a lower-trust principal, protected target, or privilege boundary.
claimed_root_cause: The test uses a predictable temporary filename and ordinary file opening without exclusive creation or symlink rejection.

trace.description: Direct execution invokes the manual sabotage test's main function.
The main function calls the sabotage helper for an audit-tool mutation.
The helper opens the fixed temporary backup path with truncating write mode, which may follow a preexisting symlink.

evidence.description: The sabotage test is documented for manual execution when the audit tool or scope changes.
The backup path is a fixed audit_backup.py name under tempfile.gettempdir().
The backup path is opened in wb mode without exclusive creation or symlink rejection.
The helper later restores the repository tool by copying from the backup path.
The helper removes the backup path during cleanup.

reason: Independent source review confirms predictable temporary-path handling but found no lower-trust local principal, protected target, or meaningful privilege boundary. The manual test affects the invoking repository user's own files; the evidence supports a local hardening concern only, not a security finding.
